headline: Check Local Access for the Llŷn Coastal Path
reservation: Access to the Llŷn Coast Path is generally open via public rights of way, though local segments may have seasonal management. Distinguish between general coastal access and specific parking or accommodation requirements by checking current status with the National Landscape authorities.

days.title: Coast Path Exploration

stops.name: Llŷn
stops.detail: Walk the coastal path between Aberdesach and Carreg y Defaid to view sea cliffs, islands, and historic remains like old quarries and jetties.

days.driving: Allow for local transfers between trailheads; conditions vary by weather.
days.note: Scan History Point QR signs along the path for information on maritime and industrial heritage.

intel.title: Coastal Connectivity
intel.text: The path follows the coastline as closely as possible from the north coast near Aberdesach to the south at Llanbedrog. Users should follow the waymarked Wales Coast Path signage.

intel.title: Wildlife Watching
intel.text: Grey seals and various sea birds are frequently visible along the cliffs. Dolphins may be spotted occasionally depending on sea conditions.

intel.title: Trailhead Parking
intel.text: Evidence does not specify exact parking lot locations or fill times. Verify designated parking areas in Aberdesach or Llanbedrog before starting the walk.

intel.title: Regional Services
intel.text: Specific fuel station locations are not identified in the source material. Ensure your vehicle is fueled in larger nearby towns before entering rural coastal stretches.

intel.title: Digital Information
intel.text: History Point QR signs require a mobile signal to access data. Coverage can be inconsistent near sea cliffs, so download maps in advance.

plan.arrival: Pick up a rental in a regional transport hub and head to the northern trailhead at Aberdesach to begin the coastal journey southward.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are suitable for gateway towns, but check for local road width restrictions on rural lanes leading to path access points.
plan.goldenHour: Carreg y Defaid provides a scenic southern vista for late afternoon light, though visibility depends on seasonal weather patterns.
